rdfs:label: Account
rdfs:comment: A Solid pod account — the user account on a Solid server, distinct from the WebID it issues.
notes: Solid-specific account class — represents the user record held by a Solid server (login credentials, owned pods). Upstream it is just "A Solid account"; `solid:storageQuota` and `solid:storageUsage` are its only defined properties. Distinct from `urn:solid:OnlineAccount` (the FOAF generic account-on-a-service class) and from `urn:solid:account` (the FOAF property pointing at any online account). An Account may own several pods and WebIDs (e.g. in CSS).

examples.title: WebID linking to its pod account with a storage quota

history.note: Initial term — Class form completing the Account/account case-pair, mapped to solid:Account (distinct from foaf:OnlineAccount, already covered by urn:solid:OnlineAccount).
Example uses solid:storageQuota instead of nonexistent webid term; notes drop invented billing/one-pod claims.
